secondary_reference.note: Yahoo chart is a progressive secondary quote reference only; every row carries its verified market date and official TWSE/TPEx values remain primary.

yahoo_details.note: Official values remain primary. Yahoo data fills missing fields; stale per-symbol rows and source errors are exposed instead of being hidden by a fresh file timestamp.

data_verification.verification_basis: isolated stock/ETF adapters; per-symbol source timestamps when available; financial conflicts require comparable period basis
